summary: Round-8 (DOB Prompt, Service Targets, CSV Column Picker) fully tested. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_round8_features.py — 27/27 passing. DOB: GET /api/members/missing_dob/ returns [] for admin/supervisor/caseworker (correctly scoped); PATCH member DOB to null makes it appear with keys {id,name,household_id,org_household_number}, restore removes it. Service Targets: GET /api/service-targets/ lists 2 workers with monthly_goal for admin+supervisor, 403 for caseworker+capturer; PUT upserts (idempotent verified via re-GET), 403 for non-supervisor; /api/services/stats/ ranking rows include delivered/goal/goal_percent, caseworker's staff dict carries goal+goal_percent (23/15 = 153%). CSV Picker: no ?columns → full 6-col header; ?columns=date,service_type → 2-col header + 2 data cells; invalid or empty falls back to all 6; still 403 for caseworker/capturer. Regression: trend 4 buckets, beneficiary_reminders, monthly_detail.missed, bulk_log, completeness_bands, ?band= filter, version-lock 409/200 all green. Frontend Playwright (supervisor): export-service-csv-button opens csv-column-picker with all 6 csv-col-* checkboxes + csv-download-button; ranking-goal-<uid> renders (1 bar for user 3 with goal=15); Service Targets nav item visible; /settings/targets shows target-row-*, target-input-*, target-save-* for 2 workers; saving a target succeeds. Caseworker (Cindy, user 3): staff-goal-bar visible showing '23/15 (153%)', export button hidden, Service Targets nav hidden, and /settings/targets shows friendly 403 message ('Only supervisors and administrators can set service targets.'). DOB nudges: after nulling member 1 DOB, admin dashboard rendered dob-missing-card with dob-missing-row-1 ('Deanna Radebe · TEST-0001 · Add DOB'), household detail /households/1 rendered member-dob-missing-1 amber 'Add date of birth' nudge, clicking dob-missing-row-1 correctly navigated to /members/1/edit. Member 1 DOB restored to 2021-02-20 (missing_dob count back to 0).
critical_code_review_comments: core/views.py is now 1088 lines (was 1009 in iter-7) — still well past the 700-line split threshold; ServiceTargetView + missing_dob + export column-picker were added in-place. Recommend extracting ServiceDeliveryViewSet + ServiceTargetView into core/views_services.py and Household/Assessment/Verification into their own modules.

ServiceTargetView permission check is duplicated between get() and put() — both reject non-supervisor/admin with the same 4-line block. Since IsStaffRole already gates the class, consider a small helper or a custom permission class (IsSupervisorOrAdmin) to DRY this up (also used in stats/export gating).

export() honours ?columns but silently ignores unknown keys AND falls back to all-columns when the intersection is empty. This is per-spec but a supervisor typo (e.g. ?columns=data instead of date) yields the full 6-col CSV with no warning. Consider returning 400 when a non-empty ?columns has zero valid entries.
missing_dob action returns a plain list without pagination. On a large org (10k members × 30% missing DOB) this could return 3000 rows uncapped. Consider limiting to top-N or paginating.

ServiceTargetView.put does not validate that the target user is actually a case worker — an admin could set a monthly_goal on any user_id (supervisor, capturer, admin). Silent but leaves orphan ServiceTarget rows that never surface. Recommend filtering user_id to groups__name=ROLE_CASE_WORKER before update_or_create.
